title: Waterfall-modulated $α$-attractors
summary: Hybrid $α$-attractor models \cite{Kallosh:2022ggf} can have significantly greater values of $n_{s}$ and smaller $r$, while preserving the relation $r\cong 3α(1-n_s)^2$, which is valid for exponential T- and E-models at large values of the inflaton field. Here we study single-field $α$-attractors with features inspired by hybrid models: one can uplift the potential, and one can also have a waterfall regime that leads to a premature termination of inflation near the critical point $\varphi_c$.
